reply_text:
I couldn't confirm the 16 August deadline for Tamsin Cold Chain's signed order form, so I'm treating it as unverified.

I replied to Pree in the thread on her message in #central-team. I only checked what she can see herself: #central-team and the Central team summaries and other shared files. None of them mention Tamsin Cold Chain, and there's no Tamsin account folder she has access to.

16 August is already two months past (today is 19 October). So the date may have been misheard, may be an old deadline, or may mean next year. I suggested she ask her Tamsin contact to confirm it in writing, or check with whoever owns the account.
